{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df["revenue"] = df["revenue"].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Remove QA orders from the dataset for the mean calculation
filtered_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders excluding QA orders
mean_revenue_excluding_qa = filtered_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_revenue_excluding_qa"}
